description: Foundation-tier skills shipped with the claw distribution. Every company gets these auto-mirrored into its foundation/skills/ dir on `claw co create` / `claw co update`. Content lives under res/foundation/<name>/.

tools.description: Manage your capability surface: discover hidden tools by intent, delegate to peers, forge new MCP tools when nothing fits, capture reusable workflows as skills. Universal — granted to every agent.
